YOUR INFORMATION

A thoughtful approach
to your privacy.

A clear explanation of how this website handles enquiries and links to other services.

✳

ON THIS PAGE

Your décor preview photosThe details you enterReviewing and sendingExternal servicesHosting and technical informationImages and client informationQuestions about your information
01

Your décor preview photos

Selecting a venue photo keeps it in your browser until you consent and generate. A resized image, your selected décor reference and optional notes are then processed through our server by OpenAI. We do not store these photos or generated previews in a database or public gallery. OpenAI may retain data under its API data policies. Cloudflare Turnstile verifies requests to help prevent automated abuse. Download anything you want to keep before clearing the studio or closing the page.

02

The details you enter

The enquiry form uses your name, contact number, event preferences and any optional details to prepare a WhatsApp message. The website does not save these entries to a database or send them automatically to the team.

03

Reviewing and sending

When you continue, WhatsApp opens with the prepared message. You can review, edit or choose not to send it. If you send it, the details are shared directly with Purple Fox through WhatsApp. Avoid including information that is unnecessary for your event enquiry.

04

External services

WhatsApp and Instagram are operated by their respective providers. Their own privacy terms and account settings apply when you follow a link or use those services. Google Fonts is used to load the website’s typography.

05

Hosting and technical information

The hosting provider may process routine request information, such as IP addresses and browser information, to deliver and secure the website. This website does not add advertising trackers or visitor analytics.

06

Images and client information

Current event images are AI-generated styling concepts. They are not photographs of completed client events. Client photographs, names and testimonials should only be published after appropriate approval.

07

Questions about your information

For a question about an enquiry or information you have shared directly with Purple Fox, contact the team on WhatsApp at +91 70755 05617. This website has no customer account or saved enquiry dashboard.
